module: Manages mission progress (saving): attempts, aggregates (best result, number of tries, leaderboards), unlocked stars, quick travel and settings unlocks, career rewards and Steam achievements. Data is written to settings/cloud/missionProgress/<slot>/<mission id>.json. It also formats this data for the UI (mission screen, big map). A modder uses it to record an attempt (newAttempt then aggregateAttempt) or read a mission's progress.
usage:
local attempt = gameplay_missions_progress.newAttempt('completed', {time = 42.3})
attempt.unlockedStars = {justFinish = true}
local change = gameplay_missions_progress.aggregateAttempt('gridmap_v2/timeTrial/x', attempt)
gameplay_missions_progress.saveMissionSaveData('gridmap_v2/timeTrial/x')
notes: Attempt type priority (the smallest is the best): completed=0, passed=10, attempted=20, abandoned=50, failed=100, none=1000.

sanitizeAttempt (called by aggregateAttempt) recomputes the attempt type from the stars: 'passed' if at least one default star is obtained, 'completed' if all default AND active bonus stars are obtained, otherwise 'none'. The type passed to newAttempt is therefore overwritten. Only the stars that are active, visible and enabled for the current settings (mission.lastUserSettings) are kept.

In career, the rewards of each star are added to the player's attributes; money is multiplied by the branch's level multiplier (career_branches.getLevelRewardMultiplier). reduceCareerRewardsForDefaultStars then reduces money to 10% for an already obtained star, and sets vouchers to 0.

In batch mode (startBatchMode), aggregateAttempt neither computes unlocks nor writes the permanent log, and returns {}: useful for injecting many test attempts. Outside batch mode (and outside the shipping version), the result is written to permaMissionProgressLog.json (which grows with each attempt).
aggregateAttempt does NOT save to disk: you must then call saveMissionSaveData (or career_modules_missionWrapper.saveMission in career).

missionHasQuickTravelUnlocked and missionHasUserSettingsUnlocked always return true in the cases that matter: the code using saveData.quickTravelUnlocked / userSettingsUnlocked is commented out (the unlock still exists in aggregateAttempt, but is no longer consulted).

Several exported fields are nil: formatAggregatesForMissionTypeWithProgKey, getProgressAggregateCache, getSaveSlotVersion, setSaveSlotVersion and startConditionMet are assigned to M.xxx from locals never defined in the file (leftovers from old code).
In missionHasQuickTravelUnlocked and missionHasUserSettingsUnlocked, the error message uses the variable `id` which does not exist (the parameter is named missionId): it will print nil.
The version constant is 20 ("increasing the version purges all dev/test saves").
onExtensionLoaded loads all files from the gameplay/missions/progress/conditions folder and registers their condition types.

formatAggregatesForMissionTypeWithProgKe.desc: Is nil: the local of the same name does not exist in the file.

getProgressAggregateCache.desc: Is nil: the local of the same name does not exist in the file.

getSaveSlotVersion.desc: Is nil: the local of the same name does not exist in the file.

setSaveSlotVersion.desc: Is nil: the local of the same name does not exist in the file.

startConditionMet.desc: Is nil: the local of the same name does not exist in the file.

testHelper.desc: Internal test tools (e.g. testHelper.randomAttemptType, used by sanitizeMissionAfterCreation for getRandomizedAttempt).

newAttempt.desc: Creates an attempt table {type, date (os.time), humanDate (ISO 8601 UTC), data}.

type.desc: Result type: completed, passed, attempted, abandoned, failed or none (will be recomputed by aggregateAttempt).

data.desc: Data specific to the mission type.

aggregateAttempt.desc: Records an attempt in a mission's progress: sanitizes the attempt, adds it to progress.attempts, updates the aggregate (best type, number of tries, DNF, "recent" leaderboard), emits onMissionAttemptAggregated(attempt, mission, progressKey), unlocks the stars, achievements (CHALLENGE_ONE_STAR, CHALLENGE_THREE_STARS and the mission type's), applies the automatic aggregates and mission:aggregateAttempt, distributes career rewards and computes the unlocks (missions, leagues, quick travel, settings).

attempt.desc: Attempt (newAttempt); modified in place (type, unlockedStars, attemptNumber, dnfCount).

progressKey.desc: Progress key; defaults to mission.defaultProgressKey or 'default'.

returns.desc: Outside batch mode: {formattedAttempt, aggregateChange, unlockChange, nextMissionsUnlock, unlockedMissions, unlockedStarsAttempt, unlockedStarsChanged, starRewards, formattedRewards, unlockedLeagues?, quickTravelUnlockedChange?, userSettingsUnlockedChange?}. In batch mode: {}. nil if the mission does not exist.

addCareerRewardInfo.desc: Prepares, for the career end-of-mission UI, the reward details per attribute (total, icon, detail per star obtained, animation duration and sound pitch computed by a sigmoid-like curve). Does nothing outside career.

starRewards.desc: starRewards table built by aggregateAttempt (originalRewardsPerStar, sums...).

setSaveSlot.desc: Changes the save slot: the path becomes settings/cloud/missionProgress/<slotName>/.

setSavePath.desc: Directly sets the save folder; with no argument, returns to the default slot.

getSaveSlot.desc: Returns the current save slot name and its folder.

saveMissionSaveData.desc: Writes mission.saveData to <folder>/<id>.json (indented JSON) after setting dirtyDate on it.

returns.desc: Result of jsonWriteFile; nil if the mission does not exist.

loadMissionSaveData.desc: Loads a mission's progress data from disk (converts old star booleans to counters, notifies career, updates if the version is old, calls mission:loadSaveData). Returns blank data if the file is missing or unreadable.

returns.desc: true if the data was updated to a newer version.

ensureProgressExistsForKey.desc: Creates, if missing, the progress of a key (blank aggregate bestType='none', empty attempts, empty "recent" leaderboard).

reduceCareerRewardsForDefaultStars.desc: In career, reduces the rewards of each already-obtained active star (money to 10% of the original value, vouchers to 0) then recomputes the reward sums. Outside career, only recomputes the sums.

setDynamicStarRewards.desc: For each star, asks mission:getDynamicStarReward(key, userSettings) for a settings-dependent reward and substitutes it if it exists, then recomputes the sums.

missionHasQuickTravelUnlocked.desc: Indicates whether quick travel to the mission is unlocked. Always returns true for an existing mission (the save condition is commented out).

returns.desc: true (false if the mission does not exist).

missionHasUserSettingsUnlocked.desc: Indicates whether the mission's user settings are unlocked. Always returns true for an existing mission.

returns.desc: true (false if the mission does not exist).

getLeaderboardChangeKeys.desc: Returns the leaderboard -> new-record key table: 'recent' -> 'newRecentLeaderboardEntryKey', plus those of the automatic aggregates (leaderboardKey -> newLeaderboardEntryKey).

returns.desc: Mapping (empty if the mission does not exist).

formatAttemptSimple.desc: Formats an attempt for the UI: list {value, label, mainResult} based on mission.autoUiAttemptProgress.

tryBuildContext.desc: Builds a translation context table from `data`, keeping only string or number values (converted to string). Returns {} if label is nil.

label.desc: Label; if nil, the context is empty.

formatStars.desc: Formats the mission's stars for the UI (sorted list, number unlocked default/bonus, total). Returns {disabled=true} if the mission has no active stars.

formatSaveDataForUi.desc: Formats a mission's entire progress (per progress key) for the mission screen, including automatic replay recordings (core_replay.getMissionReplayFiles).

fillAttempts.desc: Include the full list of attempts (inferred from code).

returns.desc: Formatted data; nil if the mission does not exist.

formatSaveDataForBigmap.desc: Formats the progress for the big map (aggregates configured in mission.autoUiBigmap, unlocked stars).

returns.desc: Formatted data; nil if the mission does not exist. Notably contains unlockedStars (formatStars).

getUnlockedStarCountsForMissionById.desc: Counts the unlocked stars: returns the number of default stars and the number of unlocked bonus stars.

returns.desc: Unlocked bonus stars (0 if no stars; 0, 0, 0 if the mission is not found).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Loads all condition types from gameplay/missions/progress/conditions/*.lua into the internal conditionTypes table.

generateAttempt.desc: Test tool: creates a random attempt (mission:getRandomizedAttempt), adds addAttemptData to it, aggregates it then saves (via career_modules_missionWrapper in career, otherwise saveMissionSaveData). Does dump() calls in the console.

addAttemptData.desc: Fields added to the attempt (must not be nil).

generateAttempts.desc: Test tool: aggregates `amount` random attempts for each progress key of the mission.

startBatchMode.desc: Enables batch mode: aggregateAttempt skips the unlock computations and the permanent log.

getBatchMode.desc: Indicates whether batch mode is active.
